verdict.rationale: A hands-on community user praises ClickUp's 'ability to quickly configure task statuses' compared with Jira. First-party API docs confirm that List-level Custom Fields and custom task types exist, but the pack has no first-party documentation on how a PM creates and customizes fields or status workflows. missing for 10: first-party docs on creating and configuring custom fields, first-party docs on configuring workflow statuses, details on supported field types and status-workflow depth.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: one thing I love about ClickUp is its ability to quickly configure task statuses (which in JIRA, is the equivalent of programming a VCR).
You can add the Custom Fields from the task's current List to it's new List, using the `move_custom_fields`request body parameter.
You can use [Create Task] to set the custom task type on a task as you create it.
